# Van Zyl eye cohort: class filter sensitivity (rule written before the filtered models are trained)

<!-- glance:begin (generated by analysis/make_index.py; do not edit by hand) -->
Sensitivity build of the eye cohort without cell types that have fewer than 50 cells in a species, with models trained on it and a comparison against the models of the paper by a rule fixed in advance.

| | |
|---|---|
| Question | Model fits beyond the canonical runs: Which further seeds, platform repeats and cohort recipes were trained, and how was each recipe chosen? |
| Status | supporting (builds inputs, launches runs, or a check reported as a method detail) |
| Environment | `chimera_env` |
| Used in the paper | Supplementary Section C.21.13 (`sssec:rev-disease`) |
| How we know | described in the Extended Methods |

    sbatch --array=0-<rows-1> analysis/slurm/array.sbatch analysis/tasks/T11_8_vz_class_filter/manifest.tsv

**Notes.** README.md states the decision rule.
<!-- glance:end -->

Class filter, as on kidney and islet: a class enters the model only with at least 50 cells in each species that has it; otherwise the whole class is filtered (`P13_kidney/build.py:297-303`, `T7_9_islet/build.py:270-277`). Van Zyl build 3 has 10 class x species cells below 50.

**Filtered object** (`build_vanzyl.py --class-min 50 --out data/analysis/van_zyl_f50`; human + mouse by `training/build_subset.py` from it).
Whole class filtered, 1,196 cells (thin species in brackets): NK/T 949 (mouse 40), B cell 144 (M. fascicularis 25), unresolved corneal 42 (mouse 42), myoepithelium 40 (mouse 40), neuron 21 (human 21).
Kept by exception, reason: V2 and V3 compare each species with human over outflow classes (van Zyl's conventional or uveoscleral outflow groups, shared by human and another species): canal endothelium (mouse 25), ciliary muscle (mouse 30, pig 41), Schwann (mouse 27), corneal endothelium with human Schwalbe line (pig 34).

**Models.** Recipes unchanged except the object: human + mouse, grid 1 of `T11_2b_vz_subsets`; full cohort, the candidates of `T11_2c_count_rule` (grids 1, 2, 6), trained in parallel so the comparison uses the recipe that wins there. Seeds 42 and 43 (`manifest.tsv`): rev-vz-f50-g<k>-s<seed>, rev-vz-f50-hmouse-s<seed>. A seed failing health (NaN, collapse, frozen) is replaced by the next seed until 2 pass.

**Decision rule (per dataset; both must hold to keep the current models).** On genes shared by the filtered and current objects:
- A_cross = mean Spearman of Delta-alpha (alpha - prior as anchored) over all pairs (filtered seed, current seed in D);
- A_within = mean Spearman of Delta-alpha over all pairs of current seeds in D.
If A_cross >= A_within on both datasets, the current models stay and the filter is reported as a checked sensitivity. Otherwise every usable Van Zyl dataset is rebuilt and retrained on filtered objects, and those are used. Single-seed pairs on both sides, so a mean over seeds is not compared with a single seed. Spearman of the seed means and the same statistics on the C-residual scale are reported beside and do not decide.

**Timing, stated.** This rule reads only Delta-alpha, no gene list. It was written after V1-V3 on the current models had been computed and read by the analyst, so it cannot be described as preceding the glaucoma readout.
